# Feries.ma

> Complete calendar of Morocco's public holidays, religious celebrations, and national commemorations with multilingual support.

Feries.ma is a comprehensive holiday calendar resource for Morocco, covering Islamic holidays (Ramadan, Eid Al-Fitr, Eid Al-Adha), national celebrations (Independence Day, Throne Day, Green March), and cultural observances (Yennayer Amazigh New Year). The site is available in French, Arabic, and English to serve Morocco's diverse population.

## Key Topics

- Morocco holidays
- Islamic holidays

- Moharram
- Prophet Muhammad
- King Mohammed VI
- Public holidays
- National celebrations
- Moroccan traditions
